objective: Add an optional planner-level model for output-equivalent traditional human effort, assisted residual effort, net time savings, token/resource usage, and direct cost without conflating estimates, observations, budgets, invoices, or scientific validity.

implementation_receipt.unresolved_external_calibration: Blinded held-out expert timing and provider/invoice calibration are still required before advisory promotion.

prohibited_effects: automatic invocation for ordinary planner requests
lowering evidence, quality, review, or answer-trust requirements
planned or budgeted quantities presented as observed usage
missing effort, usage, or price presented as zero
individual productivity, salary, performance, or ROI inference
prompt, response, hidden reasoning, credential, or patient-row retention

invariants: the traditional comparator must deliver the same scope, rigor, evidence coverage, acceptance tests, and review posture
human active effort, human waiting, machine runtime, and end-to-end calendar duration remain separate
prospective and retrospective artifacts have different schemas and cannot be relabeled
negative savings and not-estimable outcomes remain visible
provider-reported usage is the only source labeled provider-observed
a configured token budget is never treated as consumed tokens
price books are immutable, effective-time resolved, and digest bound
direct execution cost and optional human labor valuation remain separate
economics cannot upgrade or downgrade scientific validity
disabled mode preserves existing planner outputs and digests

phases.name: semantics, comparator, and threat model
phases.promotion_gate: equivalence, polarity, clocks, taxonomy, evidence grades, privacy, and anti-gaming rules are frozen

phases.name: human effort and time-savings model
phases.promotion_gate: component estimates reconcile, retain negative outcomes, and expose uncertainty and residual review

phases.name: usage, price, cost, and budget model
phases.promotion_gate: token classes never double count and complete fixtures replay to exact fixed-decimal cost

phases.name: contracts and optional planner integration
phases.promotion_gate: strict artifacts are digest bound, default off, non-mutating, explicitly persisted, and standalone packaged

phases.name: benchmarks and calibration
phases.promotion_gate: adversarial escapes, interval coverage, quality parity, usage arithmetic, and privacy checks meet frozen thresholds

phases.name: rollout, monitoring, and documentation
phases.promotion_gate: shadow and audit evidence support advisory use with a pinned one-step rollback

todos.action: Freeze workflow-economics vocabulary and non-goals, including effort, elapsed time, runtime, usage, budget, estimated cost, observed spend, invoice reconciliation, and optional labor valuation.
acceptance: every user-facing quantity has an explicit unit and evidence state
the documentation prohibits productivity surveillance and a scalar ROI/trust score
planned, observed, and invoice-reconciled states cannot be confused
todos.example: A 200,000-token context budget remains a budget when the provider returns no usage receipt.
todos.rollback: remove the unreferenced design document

todos.action: Define a versioned ComparatorContract requiring output equivalence for scope, rigor, evidence coverage, provenance, reproducibility, acceptance tests, and reviews.
acceptance: the comparator represents an experienced practitioner using ordinary non-agentic tools
novice learning time and agent-only assurance cannot inflate the manual baseline
non-equivalent deliverables produce not_estimable
todos.example: A short narrative cannot be compared with a manual systematic review requiring claim locators and contradiction checks.
todos.rollback: disable economics calculation when no comparator contract exists

todos.action: Define atomic WorkUnit classes, quantity units, role classes, risk/rigor tiers, dependency semantics, and operation/output identity rules.
acceptance: reading, screening, extraction, normalization, analysis, synthesis, verification, revision, coordination, packaging, and integration remain distinguishable
each unit binds to stage and input/output artifact identities
shared or repeated work has an explicit deduplication key
todos.example: A literature stage becomes separate search, abstract-screening, full-text-reading, extraction, and adjudication units.
todos.rollback: retain workload rows as unresolved rather than applying generic stage totals

todos.action: Define source precedence, evidence grades, distribution types, correlation rules, sensitivity reporting, and explicit unknown/not-applicable states for every driver and rate.
acceptance: exact matched observations outrank benchmarks, analogues, expert priors, and generic priors
P10/P50/P90 are reproducible from a pinned policy and seed
missing evidence widens the range or produces not_estimable rather than zero
todos.example: Unknown full-text depth is surfaced as the largest sensitivity driver instead of assuming one minute per paper.
todos.rollback: return not_estimable for profiles without an approved evidence basis

todos.action: Version adversarial failure modes for planned-as-observed, runtime-as-effort, budget-as-usage, missing-as-zero, price drift, cache mispricing, retry omission, duplicate credit, novice inflation, review omission, denominator selection, and salary inference.
acceptance: each threat maps to a minimal fixture and required disposition
multi-agent parallelism cannot reduce additive person-hours by itself
quality or acceptance failure invalidates the savings headline
todos.example: Three branches reusing one search call receive one shared or unallocated cost, not three direct charges.
todos.rollback: keep advisory rollout off until all P0 threats have fixtures

todos.action: Define opt-in telemetry, privacy-scope joins, retention, aggregation, authorization, and the boundary between economics, budget enforcement, scientific quality, and release.
acceptance: prompts, outputs, hidden reasoning, credentials, and patient rows are prohibited
economics cannot change scientific route or release
budget enforcement requires distinct explicit authority
todos.example: An expensive workflow may still be scientifically valid; the report informs a human without changing its quality verdict.
todos.rollback: disable observation and persistence while retaining pure prospective calculation

todos.action: Implement a pure compiler from sealed workflow/stage DAGs to non-overlapping WorkUnits with unresolved-driver diagnostics and double-count detection.
acceptance: the input plan and route are never mutated
every output unit has stable stage/artifact bindings
combined stages decompose without inventing quantities
todos.example: A stage declaring evidence synthesis but no source count emits unresolved screening and reading quantities.
todos.rollback: expose only a workload inventory without estimates

todos.action: Implement component-level traditional manual effort from setup, quantity, throughput, complexity, friction, rigor, coordination, and expected rework distributions.
acceptance: component and workflow totals replay deterministically
experienced-practitioner assumptions and ordinary tools are visible
one-time setup is separate from marginal per-run effort
todos.example: Reusable query templates are charged once under the declared amortization horizon rather than on every run.
todos.rollback: emit workload drivers without a total

todos.action: Implement evidence-type/depth reading and complete-denominator screening models, including access, deduplication, authority/applicability review, and disagreement resolution.
acceptance: metadata, abstract, targeted lookup, and full-text critical reading have distinct rates
screening uses all candidates at the frozen cutoff
citations alone do not prove reading
todos.example: 400 hits, 60 screened abstracts, and 12 full texts produce three different work quantities.
todos.rollback: mark reading and screening components not_estimable

todos.action: Implement extraction, locator capture, unit/identifier normalization, ambiguous crosswalk, missingness, and high-risk double-extraction drivers.
acceptance: field/claim counts and schema complexity drive effort
exceptions create work instead of disappearing
critical independent review floors remain mandatory
todos.example: Forty extracted claims with five ambiguous endpoints include adjudication and provenance-locator work.
todos.rollback: fall back to an explicitly labeled generic prior

todos.action: Implement data staging, computation/debugging, evidence consolidation, contradiction handling, uncertainty, and narrative/figure/report assembly drivers.
acceptance: models, diagnostic runs, modalities, claim-evidence rows, and contradictions are explicit drivers
fluent output length does not substitute for consolidation work
cross-stage integration remains a separate line
todos.example: A multi-omics report includes modality reconciliation, identifier linkage, diagnostic reruns, and report assembly separately.
todos.rollback: omit unsupported domain-specific components from the headline denominator

todos.action: Implement assisted human effort independently from the manual baseline, including setup, unreplaced work, mandatory review, approval, correction, escalation, reruns, and coordination.
acceptance: residual effort is not an arbitrary percentage of the baseline
failed and retried work contributes expected correction effort
risk-specific review floors cannot be optimized away
todos.example: A publication-facing report retains source checking, editing, and approval even if drafting is automated.
todos.rollback: report gross displaced work only and suppress net savings

todos.action: Calculate gross displacement, assisted residual, new assurance work, net saved person-hours, saving fraction, and negative/no-saving cases with exact reconciliation.
acceptance: manual minus assisted equals net savings at component and workflow levels
negative results are never clamped
saving fractions are absent when the denominator is invalid
todos.example: A 90-minute manual task and 105-minute assisted task reports minus 15 minutes.
todos.rollback: disable the headline while retaining decomposed component estimates

todos.action: Compute human active effort, human waiting, machine runtime, and manual/assisted dependency-graph critical paths as separate distributions.
acceptance: parallelism changes critical path without erasing person-hours
machine runtime is not subtracted from human labor
missing dependency timing prevents a false calendar estimate
todos.example: Two people working two hours in parallel remain four person-hours but two elapsed hours.
todos.rollback: report person-effort only

todos.action: Implement seeded correlated uncertainty propagation, ordered P10/P50/P90 outputs, evidence grades, sensitivity attribution, and interval invalidation.
acceptance: replay is deterministic for identical inputs and seed
correlated source-count effects are preserved
confidence grade is distinct from interval width
todos.example: Increasing candidate papers jointly changes screening and reading rather than sampling them independently.
todos.rollback: use conservative low/central/high scenario propagation

todos.action: Define provider-neutral request, attempt, component, subworkflow, reservation, privacy-scope, and raw-usage receipt identities.
acceptance: retries receive distinct attempt identities
receipts bind to exact plan, component, provider configuration, and time
no prompt or response body is required
todos.example: A failed first call and successful retry are retained as two attempts under one component.
todos.rollback: accept no retrospective usage without a conforming receipt

todos.action: Define provider accounting-semantics adapters for uncached input, cached input, output, reasoning, embeddings, batch/tier, tool context, failures, cancellation, and rounding.
acceptance: raw provider usage is preserved
normalized token classes are non-overlapping
unsupported semantics yield not_calculable rather than guessed totals
todos.example: Cached tokens included in provider input totals are subtracted before uncached input is priced.
todos.rollback: report raw provider usage without normalized cost

todos.action: Estimate per-component invocation, attempt, retry, token-class, external API, compute, storage, network, and fixed-charge distributions from explicit plan drivers.
acceptance: P10/P50/P90 resource envelopes expose call-count and context/output assumptions
failed/cancelled consumption is included prospectively
cold-start heuristics remain labeled heuristic_estimated
todos.example: A critique loop estimates one base call plus a bounded retry/revision distribution, not exactly one call.
todos.rollback: emit declared budgets with no consumption estimate

todos.action: Aggregate provider-reported and locally metered receipts by component, attempt, stage, workflow, provider, and resource class with evidence-state coverage.
acceptance: only SDK/provider receipts are provider_observed tokens
tokenizer-derived and meter-observed quantities remain differently labeled
missing telemetry is not_reported and has no numeric zero
todos.example: A local tokenizer estimate remains tokenizer_derived even if it exactly matches a later provider count.
todos.rollback: suppress aggregate usage when receipt identity is incomplete

todos.action: Implement immutable price-book schemas and resolution by provider, model/service, region, tier, effective time, currency, rate dimension, authority, and digest.
acceptance: mutable prices are absent from estimator code
historical events resolve the effective historical price
missing model/category prices remain unpriced
todos.example: A price change next month does not alter replay of this month's reconciled run.
todos.rollback: report quantities without monetary totals

todos.action: Implement fixed-decimal or integer nano-currency line pricing, provider rounding, subtotals, coverage, unpriced lines, and optional pinned FX conversion.
acceptance: complete fixture totals replay exactly without floating-point drift
unpriced categories reduce coverage rather than contributing zero
FX conversion requires a separate snapshot digest
todos.example: Observed tokens with an unknown model price produce an observed usage total and not_calculable cost.
todos.rollback: disable converted and aggregate monetary presentation

todos.action: Add independent receipt adapters for paid search/database APIs, OCR, CPU/GPU, memory, storage, egress, embeddings, and user-supplied contractual fees.
acceptance: token and external-tool charges remain separate
contractual/license prices are never invented
meter class and unit are explicit
todos.example: A paid literature API request is priced once even though its result later contributes model input tokens.
todos.rollback: retain unsupported resources as unpriced lines

todos.action: Implement direct/shared/unallocated component attribution with declared allocation methods and exact subtotal reconciliation.
acceptance: shared events are never charged repeatedly
an unallocated bucket remains available
component totals plus unallocated equal the workflow total
todos.example: One orchestration call serving three analysis branches remains one workflow cost line.
todos.rollback: report workflow totals without component allocation

todos.action: Implement explicitly authorized P90 reservations, deterministic multi-scope locking, release, expiry, partial/late reconciliation, and idempotency using CostGuard-compatible state rules.
acceptance: reserved, observed-not-invoiced, and reconciled spend remain separate
concurrent reservations cannot overspend a scope
confined paths, atomic replacement, locks, and append-only ledgers are tested
todos.example: A cancelled run releases unused reservation while retaining any billable observed attempts.
todos.rollback: disable budget mode without affecting estimate or observe modes

todos.action: Reconcile provider observations with authoritative billing exports while retaining estimate-to-observed and observed-to-invoice variances and discrepancies.
acceptance: invoice reconciliation never rewrites original receipts
late and partial lines are idempotent
discrepancies are visible by provider/accounting semantics
todos.example: Provider rounding creates a small invoice delta that remains diagnostic rather than silently altering token counts.
todos.rollback: stop at provider_observed estimated cost

todos.action: Add strict Draft 2020-12 schemas for comparator, work unit, effort estimate/assessment, resource estimate/usage, usage receipt, price book, reservation, reconciliation, and economics report.
acceptance: additionalProperties is false at controlled boundaries
polarity, units, evidence state, uncertainty, currency, coverage, and digests are required where applicable
prospective documents cannot validate as retrospective documents
todos.example: A resource estimate containing observed_spend fails schema validation.
todos.rollback: leave new schemas unregistered

todos.action: Register contracts and validate digest binding, unique IDs, arithmetic, ordered intervals, allowed units, nonnegative usage, effective prices, subtotal coverage, and no unknown-as-zero semantics.
acceptance: tampered totals and digests fail
manual minus assisted equals saved effort
priced plus unpriced coverage reconciles without fabricated zeros
todos.example: A cached-token line counted as both cached and uncached is rejected.
todos.rollback: do not expose invalid artifacts at the public boundary

todos.action: Add digest-bound workflow-economics policy, default-off non-executing profile, manifest metadata, and resource packaging without modifying scientific skills or workflows.
acceptance: default mode is off
generic priors are explicitly uncalibrated
profile authority is planning-only and non-executing
todos.example: Installing the planner package makes the estimator resources available but does not invoke them.
todos.rollback: remove the manifest entry and packaged resources

todos.action: Add default-off entrypoint/staged-routing arguments and attach prospective economics only after the plan and comparator are sealed, without route, candidate, refinement, or release mutation.
acceptance: disabled outputs and digests are byte-identical
explicit estimate mode returns only prospective sidecars
direct-use and control-plane behavior remain unchanged
todos.example: A normal workflow-planning request returns no economics fields unless explicitly enabled.
todos.rollback: remove the optional keyword arguments and sidecar projection

todos.action: Add explicit retrospective authorization, exact-input binding, tamper rejection, and ArtifactStore persistence under planner run economics paths; never write implicitly.
acceptance: workflow, run, telemetry, comparator, policy, calibration, and price-book digests are bound
persistence requires an authorized assessment
path traversal and privacy-scope mismatch are rejected
todos.example: Changing a usage receipt after authorization invalidates reconciliation and persistence.
todos.rollback: retain pure in-memory calculation only

todos.action: Export stable APIs, extend the deprecated facade module allowlist, and add standalone wheel/sdist verification for modules, schemas, policy, and profile.
acceptance: the package works outside the repository root
resource loading is deterministic
legacy import compatibility remains intact
todos.example: A temporary environment installs the wheel and validates an off-mode and fixture estimate.
todos.rollback: remove public exports while keeping internal fixtures

todos.action: Build an economics card showing comparator, P10/P50/P90 manual and assisted effort, negative/net savings, component decomposition, residual reviews, resource/cost classes, coverage, assumptions, exclusions, and sensitivities.
acceptance: estimated versus observed banners are prominent
no scalar hides component uncertainty or unpriced categories
the report says it is not employee productivity telemetry
todos.example: Observed tokens with 82% cost coverage show the unknown API category next to the priced subtotal.
todos.rollback: return machine-readable artifacts only

todos.action: Implement selective invalidation and replay so workload changes affect effort/resources, usage changes affect usage/cost, and price changes affect cost but never token counts or effort.
acceptance: invalidation reasons and re-entry owners are explicit
unaffected artifacts retain their receipts
all calculations retain seed and unrounded inputs
todos.example: A new price book recalculates cost while preserving the original observed token receipt.
todos.rollback: invalidate the complete economics bundle conservatively

todos.action: Create frozen development and sealed-validation cases spanning small literature triage, systematic evidence review, multi-omics analysis, deterministic transforms, reporting, human-heavy approvals, and repeated workflows.
acceptance: cases include exact comparator, workload, ranges, equivalence disposition, and expected diagnostics
reading, selection, extraction, consolidation, verification, coordination, and amortization are covered
sealed cases remain blinded during calibration
todos.example: A plasma multi-omics case exposes integration/debugging and scientific-review overhead rather than only report-writing time.
todos.rollback: retain benchmarks as non-authoritative fixtures

todos.action: Add adversarial cases for skim-as-read, duplicate records, parallel double credit, ignored review, cached-work inflation, optimistic unknowns, quality mismatch, failed retries, selective denominator, and negative savings.
acceptance: every threat has a deterministic oracle
not_equivalent and not_estimable outcomes render correctly
no fixture can obtain positive savings by omitting required work
todos.example: A workflow with 105 minutes of assisted effort against 90 manual minutes must remain negative.
todos.rollback: block advisory rollout

todos.action: Build exact fixtures for token-class semantics, caches, reasoning/output inclusion, tool context, retries, failures, cancellations, shared costs, historical prices, rounding, missing prices, FX, and invoice deltas.
acceptance: complete fixtures have 100% exact arithmetic replay
budget-as-usage and missing-as-zero have zero escapes
provider receipt remains the usage oracle and price book remains the cost oracle
todos.example: A cached-input provider fixture detects addition of cached tokens to a total that already includes them.
todos.rollback: disable monetary output while retaining raw fixture usage

todos.action: Implement frozen blinded expert calibration with matched output-quality tests, reviewer role/experience, disagreement, bias, error, interval coverage, residual-effort underestimation, and false-positive savings metrics.
acceptance: manual and assisted work are calibrated independently of automated runtime
displayed evaluation cases are not used for tuning
quality parity is required before time-savings calibration counts
todos.example: A fast but scientifically incomplete agent output is excluded rather than credited with large savings.
todos.rollback: label all profiles generic_prior and keep advisory off

todos.action: Build privacy-filtered component/provider resource profiles with minimum sample size, recency, drift, temporal holdout, quantile loss, interval coverage, retry calibration, overrun, cost coverage, and invoice discrepancy.
acceptance: stale or sparse profiles fall back explicitly
actual-zero cases use absolute rather than percentage error
privacy thresholds prevent sensitive singleton profiles
todos.example: A provider model revision triggers drift fallback to a wider analogous profile.
todos.rollback: use conservative heuristic estimates

todos.action: Test permutation invariance, digest replay, ordered intervals, B-A=S, critical paths, amortization, no NaN, no double counting, fixed-decimal totals, coverage, and selective invalidation.
acceptance: malformed/tampered documents fail deterministically
component order cannot change totals
unknown and partial states remain arithmetic-safe
todos.example: Permuting three shared branches does not alter their unallocated overhead total.
todos.rollback: keep modules private until properties pass

todos.action: Prove default-off exact compatibility, explicit sidecar-only invocation, prospective/observed polarity, authorization, confinement, privacy, no scientific release effect, and standalone packaging.
acceptance: existing planner fixtures and digests are unchanged when off
no scientific skill, workflow, or Prism file requires modification
wheel and sdist contain all registered resources
todos.example: An estimate with a poor savings result still leaves the existing scientific delivery decision unchanged.
todos.rollback: remove integration while preserving isolated fixtures

todos.action: Implement off, fixture, shadow, audit, and advisory states with default off, pinned rollback, and no scientific enforcement; retain budget as separate explicit authority.
acceptance: shadow and audit have no user-facing or release effect
advisory requires all promotion metrics
one-step rollback returns to off without deleting historical ledgers
todos.example: Fixture arithmetic passing alone cannot promote generic effort priors to advisory status.
todos.rollback: set effective state to off

todos.action: Freeze promotion thresholds for quality parity, effort interval coverage/bias, false-complete and false-positive-savings rates, token/cost replay, telemetry and price coverage, privacy, compatibility, latency, size, and reviewer capacity.
acceptance: effort calibration targets at least 90% declared central-interval coverage or a justified alternative
complete cost fixtures require exact arithmetic and zero polarity escapes
uncalibrated or under-reviewed evidence blocks promotion
todos.example: High token accuracy cannot compensate for poor residual-human-effort coverage.
todos.rollback: retain the last approved state and policy digest

todos.action: Monitor aggregate estimate coverage, interval calibration, drift, overruns, unpriced share, arithmetic mismatches, invalidations, latency, artifact size, privacy exceptions, and rollback triggers without content telemetry.
acceptance: metrics contain counts, labels, and opaque IDs only
domain/provider drift is separable
rollback conditions are deterministic
todos.example: A rising unpriced-cost share triggers advisory degradation without exposing prompts or source content.
todos.rollback: stop metrics ingestion and retain prior aggregate reports

todos.action: Document lifecycle placement, contracts, artifact paths, provenance joins, comparator construction, activity heuristics, price-book maintenance, report interpretation, limitations, reassessment, and concrete cards.
acceptance: researchers can distinguish manual effort, assisted effort, elapsed time, tokens, and cost
operators can trace every displayed total to components and digests
examples include negative, partial, and not-estimable results
todos.example: The guide explains why observed tokens plus an absent price produce a partial report, not zero cost.
todos.rollback: remove links to an unavailable runtime

todos.action: Record completed TODO IDs, files, schemas, policy/calibration digests, benchmark splits, validation results, effective rollout state, unresolved external calibration, and rollback target.
acceptance: receipt coverage exactly matches backlog IDs
software completion is distinguished from real-world calibration and rollout promotion
full planner and standalone validation results are reproducible
todos.example: The implementation can be complete while advisory promotion remains off pending blinded benchmark evidence.
todos.rollback: remove an invalid receipt and return status to planned

definition_of_done: all backlog items have implementation receipts and tests
every headline value decomposes to typed work or resource lines with provenance
output equivalence and quality parity cannot be bypassed
negative and not-estimable outcomes render correctly
prospective, observed, and invoice states remain distinct
missing effort, usage, and price never become zero
default-disabled planner behavior and digests are unchanged
economics has no scientific routing or release authority
strict schemas, deterministic replay, benchmarks, standalone distribution, and full planner regression pass
advisory promotion remains off until real held-out calibration meets the frozen policy
